userStories.title: Inquiry Backend, Spam Handling & SLA Endpoints
userStories.description: Enhance Inquiry model with 48h SLA deadline and spam flags, implement spam/unspam endpoints with audit logging, and calculate remaining SLA time in inquiries queries
acceptanceCriteria: Inquiry model correctly stores slaDeadline, isSpam, spamFlaggedAt, and spamFlaggedBy with proper beforeCreate and beforeValidate hooks
POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/:id/spam flags inquiry as spam with audit log record
POST /api/v1/admin/inquiries/:id/unspam restores inquiry to 'new' status with audit log record
GET /api/v1/admin/inquiries calculates slaDeadline, slaRemainingHours, and slaStatus ('critical', 'warning', 'ok', 'breached', 'resolved')
Unit tests in server/tests/inquiry.test.js or server/tests/admin.test.js pass 100%

userStories.title: Operations Dashboard Telemetry & SLA Timer
userStories.description: Provide real-time pipeline telemetry, 48-hour SLA countdown, and urgent alert banners on the Admin Dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard metrics endpoint returns urgentSlaLeads count (unreplied RFQs with < 12h remaining or overdue) and pipeline breakdown for canonical 8 statuses
Dashboard UI displays high-priority SLA warning banner when urgent leads exist
Recent inquiries table on dashboard displays live SLA badge with color coding (amber < 24h, red < 12h or breached)

userStories.title: Inquiries & RFQ Desk UI with DataTable and SLA Countdown
userStories.description: Upgrade Inquiries desk with DataTable, FilterBar, SLA countdown badges, spam triage, and human-approved AI reply composer
acceptanceCriteria: Inquiries desk uses reusable DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Table displays Reference No, Buyer Organization/Country, Products, Value/Volume, Status, SLA Timer, and Lead Score
Detail drawer displays complete buyer profile, commercial terms, line items, and audit history
AI summary and suggested reply are explicitly badged as [AI GENERATED SUGGESTION — REQUIRES HUMAN APPROVAL]
Spam action can be triggered from drawer/table with confirmation and instant filter removal
Zero visual regression on public site
